The arms

Same reference, same six chunks, same Blender recipe kit and the same budget per job. Only how the work is split and ordered changes.

The six chunks

In arm A each job sees only its crop below. In the other arms each job sees the whole figure and owns one chunk.

What we measure

Silhouette IoU
Overlap of the model's outline with the reference outline, from the same front camera. 1.0 is a perfect match.
Loss
The paper-warrior image loss: silhouette, outline distance, structure, facet edges and tone, weighted into one number. 0 is perfect.
Per-part score
Silhouette IoU inside each chunk's box, so a great torso can't hide a missing hand.
Time and cost
Wall-clock from first job to assembled model, and the model spend for all of an arm's jobs.
Fidelity check
Pass or fail by eye: this figure, not an inspired one. Five fingers per hand, a face with brow, nose and jaw, toes on bare feet.
